newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip on profit-taking.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures slipped across the board on Thursday, on sporadic profit-taking reflecting the yen's firmer tendency against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen to 0.8 yen per kg lower. Benchmark May ended 0.6 yen weaker at 144.3 yen.
In lacklustre trade, prices were trapped within narrow ranges throughout the day amid a dearth of fresh incentives.
"The resistance of 145 yen for benchmark May proved hard to break through," a trader said.
